t: You're looking at Reach, a sculpture by Pixie Mudge Massey. She is a Canadian artist and sculptor, born in 1944, and she made this piece. The title suggests an outstretched movement, a sense of stretching toward something. I don't have more detail about the story behind it, so I'll say no more than that. Walk around the sculpture and see how the form changes as you move, and what it seems to be reaching for.
